scenario_id.description: Scenario ID to run for this conversation.

avatar_id.description: Avatar ID to use for this conversation.

runtime_vars.description: Runtime variables injected into scenario templates.

stt_keywords.description: Optional keywords used in the speech-to-text step of the pipeline to improve recognition of specific words in user speech (maximum 5).

record_conversation.description: If true, enable recording for this conversation session.

room_url.description: Daily room URL for the session.

token.description: Daily access token for joining the room.

call_is_ready.description: True when bot and participant are ready.

completion_percent.description: Progress percentage for setup and readiness (0-100).

href.description: Relative app URL for the avatar or catalog detail page.

profile_image_url.description: Signed profile image URL if available, otherwise an empty string.

LlmModel.description: OpenAI chat model for this scenario. Defaults to gpt-4.1-mini. Full-size models require a paid plan.

NodesJson.description: Scenario flow JSON. See the Using JSON guide for the full contract.

id.description: Existing hosted link ID. Required to keep/update a link on scenario update. Omit to create a new link.

runtime_vars.description: Must include a key for every {{runtime.*}} variable the scenario references. Blank values are allowed.

redirect_url.description: Optional http(s) URL to send the visitor after the call ends.

url.description: Public hosted-link URL, for example https://live.akapulu.com/session/<token>.

hosted_links.description: Optional hosted links to create with the scenario.
If present, this array is the full set of hosted links after the update. Links omitted from the array are deleted. Omit this field to leave existing links unchanged.
